text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I notice Sweep Tosho behind the school building acting a bit suspiciously.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A forbidden spell… I'm a little scared, but I'll give it a try…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: According to the grimoire, this will summon a great big dragon that can take out a small village no problem…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: If I can summon that, I bet everyone will be super surprised and do whatever I say!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I can even scare Trainer into giving me a break from racing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems as though all the consecutive races have put a lot of pressure on her. I might want to rethink her schedule…
